question: PaLM-E 如何把传感信息与语言联系起来？

gold_quotes.quote: Inputs such as images and state estimates are embedded into the same latent embedding as language tokens and processed by the self-attention layers of a Transformer-based LLM in the same way as text.
This is realized by encoding the continuous observations into a sequence of vectors with the same dimension as the embedding space of the language tokens.
These vectors are then interleaved with normal embedded text tokens to form the prefix for the LLM.
